summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a routine Form 6-K, its equivalent of a US current report, furnishing interim financial information for the period ended June 30, 2026. The disclosure highlights supplier and customer concentration, related-party balances, and subsequent events including a convertible promissory note private placement dated September 2026, plus ADS-related transactions. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist, strategic review, or similar special situation is announced. Terms such as price per share, premium, or deal value are absent, and no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is ordinary periodic reporting with no risk-arb angle.
